content: The absent keyphrase prediction highly prefers recall-oriented models, therefore CopyRNN with beam size of 200 is innately proper for this task setting. Howerer, from the results we observe that with the help of exhaustive decoding and diverse mechanisms, INLINEFORM0 is able to perform comparably to CopyRNN model, and it generally works better for top predictions. Even though the trend of models' performance somewhat matches what we observe on the present data, we argue that it is hard to compare different models' performance on such scale. We argue that StackEx is better testbeds for absent keyphrase generation.
